The '''''Burning Vengeance''''' was one of two [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] that were fitted with an experimental weapons system designed by [[House Andrim]]. It was fitted with the weapons system at the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] and was sent along with the [[Legacy (Star Destroyer)|''Legacy'']] to the planet [[Belgaroth]] for testing. House Andrim sent freelance agents to monitor the tests so they could negotiate a fair price for the weapons once their effectiveness was demonstrated.<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds" />
